products.title: Face
products.body_html: Gently exfoliate your skin and repair your barrier with this duo of transformative essentials. Skin Refine Pore Clearing Serum helps to decongest and refine pores, smooths texture and hydrates with mandelic and salicylic acids and glycerin. Daily Recovery Rich Barrier Cream delivers deep hydration in a breathable, silky formula that restores moisture, strengthens your barrier, and calms skin instantly.

products.title: PM Routine
products.body_html: This smoothing body duo visibly transforms rough, dull, uneven skin. Our creamy exfoliating scrub has AHAs (lactic and glycolic acids) that work hand-in-hand with microfine pumice to banish bumps, target hyperpigmentation, and polish away dry patches, leaving skin soft and radiant. It's paired with our best-selling retinol-infused body lotion, which helps target body breakouts, chicken skin, strawberry legs, and more for smooth-as-glass skin all over.

products.title: Daily Routine
products.body_html: The double cleanse for skin that's clean, never stripped. First, the oil-based Cleansing Balm melts into a creamy milk that removes makeup and impurities while leaving skin feeling nourished and hydrated. For your second cleanse, Daily Gel Cleanser builds into a rich lather that lifts away remaining traces of the day without stripping your skin’s moisture barrier. Your complexion is left feeling clean and nourished —with no oily residue, tightness, or dryness.

products.title: Day Dissolve
products.body_html: Designed with a rich body and luxurious lather, this gentle cleanser effortlessly lifts away makeup, dirt, and impurities while replenishing skin with barrier-supporting hydration, never leaving it feeling stripped.

products.title: Face and Cheeks
products.body_html: Perfect your skin and create an instant flushed look with this good-for-skin set. Using our Multi-Tasking Brush, apply the Skin Solution Skin Tint all over to even out your complexion and perfect skin. Then, add a natural-looking flush with the Shade Swipe Blush Stick—it adds buildable color that melts into skin.

products.body_html: Define your eyes with our staples for brows and lashes. Our Tinted Brow Gel gives the easiest fluffy brow in just a few swipes. And our Lifting and Defining Mascara glides on easily with a brush that was designed to coat every lash for that soft, fluttery look without clumping.

Add a pop of color to your cheeks with Blush Stick. Finish with Illuminating Stick on the high points of your face, adding a soft glow to the skin.

products.title: Face
products.body_html: Discover deep hydration that feels lightweight and seamless under makeup. This duo pairs our Daily Recovery Rich Barrier Cream, a deeply nourishing yet lightweight daily moisturizer that strengthens your skin barrier with a 7-lipid complex, with our Skin Solution Multi-Serum Skin Tint SPF 40, a serum-infused skin tint that evens tone and adds hydration. Both formulas are non-comedogenic, so they won’t clog pores. Together, they create a smooth, healthy-looking makeup base that won’t pill or break you out—just effortless prep for makeup or your best bare-skin days.

products.title: Lips and Cheeks
products.body_html: Add an instant pop of color to lips and cheeks with this buildable trio. Lip Serum gives lips lightweight hydration and a sheer wash of glossy (but not sticky) natural color. Or, for a softer, natural matte finish with buildable color, Lip Blush is your go-to. Layer them together or wear them alone for customizable lip looks. For a pop of color on cheeks, Shade Swipe Blush Stick adds a natural flush of color that builds easily and melts right into skin.

This skincare-infused formula instantly melts into skin for a weightless feel that’s never sticky or greasy. Blendable, buildable pigment goes on seamlessly for a bronzed flush that won’t look blotchy or patchy, just natural on skin. Non-comedogenic and sensitive-skin safe.

products.body_html: Create any lip look with this trio of lip essentials. Line and define lips with Lip Frame Defining Lip Liner, then top with Cashmere Color Smoothing Lip Blush or Soft Gloss Tinted Lip Serum. Each formula hydrates and nourishes lips while delivering comfortable color.

products.title: Lip Frame
products.body_html: A better way to line your lips. This hydrating, blendable lip liner enhances your lips with just enough color, pigment, and hydration. Creamy and comfortable, this formula softly defines and contours with nude shades that create naturally fuller-looking lips easily.

products.title: Face Perfector
products.body_html: Designed to give you effortless control, this dual-ended brush works with Brightening Setting Powder to give you natural, softly-blurred skin. The flat side presses product into skin to smooth and set crease-prone areas, while the fluffy side softly diffuses for an all-over, blurred effect. Made with ultra-soft vegan bristles, it works beyond powder too—think bronzer, blush, highlighter, or even concealer—for a seamless, real-skin finish every time.

products.title: Smooth Finish
products.body_html: More than just a setting powder, this dual-toned, skin-loving formula brightens, blurs, and sets—without flattening your glow. Lightweight and infused with hyaluronic acid, it smooths without caking or creasing, helps makeup last, and keeps skin feeling comfortable all day. Talc-free, non-comedogenic, and made for even the most sensitive skin.

products.title: Face
products.body_html: Gently exfoliate your skin and repair your barrier with this duo of transformative essentials. Skin Refine Pore Clearing Serum helps to decongest and refine pores, smooths texture and hydrates with mandelic and salicylic acids and glycerin. Daily Recovery Rich Barrier Cream delivers deep hydration in a breathable, silky formula that restores moisture, strengthens your barrier, and calms skin instantly.

products.title: Face
products.body_html: Prep and perfect your skin for a smoother-looking complexion and skin-like coverage. Skin Refine gently smooths texture and refines the look of pores. Follow with our lightweight, hydrating Skin Tint to hydrate, protect, and deliver a natural finish that looks like your skin—only smoother.

products.title: Skin Refine
products.body_html: Everything you want in a serum, Skin Refine Gentle Pore Clearing Serum gently exfoliates and hydrates skin to deliver glass skin overnight. Mandelic and salicylic acids work together to smooth texture, refine pores, and help to clarify skin without breaking your barrier.

products.title: Face
products.body_html: Discover deep hydration that feels lightweight and seamless under makeup. This duo pairs our Daily Recovery Rich Barrier Cream, a deeply nourishing yet lightweight daily moisturizer that strengthens your skin barrier with a 7-lipid complex, with our Skin Solution Multi-Serum Skin Tint SPF 40, a serum-infused skin tint that evens tone and adds hydration. Both formulas are non-comedogenic, so they won’t clog pores. Together, they create a smooth, healthy-looking makeup base that won’t pill or break you out—just effortless prep for makeup or your best bare-skin days.

products.title: Daily Recovery
products.body_html: The lightest rich cream you’ve ever used, made for daily use. Daily Recovery Rich Barrier Cream delivers deep hydration in a breathable, silky formula that restores moisture, strengthens your barrier, and calms skin instantly. Wear it during the day for seamless makeup application that doesn't pill and before bed to restore your skin's barrier overnight. Non-comedogenic and accepted by the National Eczema Association, it’s safe for sensitive skin, leaving skin softer, smoother, and visibly healthier over time.

products.title: Daily Routine Staples
products.body_html: Cleanse, exfoliate, and hydrate skin with this set of our best-selling essentials. Double cleanse with Day Dissolve and Day Maker for smooth, replenished skin. Then add everyday, bouncy hydration with Dew Point, and brighten the eye area with Weekend Glow Eye Gel. Designed to work together as a routine, these essentials can also be used individually.

products.title: Lips and Cheeks
products.body_html: Add an instant pop of color to lips and cheeks with this buildable trio. Lip Serum gives lips lightweight hydration and a sheer wash of glossy (but not sticky) natural color. Or, for a softer, natural matte finish with buildable color, Lip Blush is your go-to. Layer them together or wear them alone for customizable lip looks. For a pop of color on cheeks, Shade Swipe Blush Stick adds a natural flush of color that builds easily and melts right into skin.

products.title: Face and Cheeks
products.body_html: Perfect your skin and create an instant flushed look with this good-for-skin set. Using our Multi-Tasking Brush, apply the Skin Solution Skin Tint all over to even out your complexion and perfect skin. Then, add a natural-looking flush with the Shade Swipe Blush Stick—it adds buildable color that melts into skin.

products.title: Face and Eyes
products.body_html: Brighten, conceal and define your eyes with this awakening trio. Weekend Glow Eye Gel brightens and depuffs the eye area with vitamin C and caffeine. Then, our Skin Solution Serum Concealer hides dark circles and perfects the skin, while its skincare ingredients help depuff and smooth. Add definition and make your eyes pop with our Lifting and Defining Mascara, which delivers a natural, fluttery look while helping to strengthen lashes.

products.title: Face
products.body_html: Everything you need for flawless, smooth skin and a perfect-looking complexion is in this kit. After prepping your skin, use your Multi-Tasking Brush to apply Skin Tint. It delivers lightweight coverage and mineral SPF 40, with a natural, radiant finish. Follow with our Serum Concealer anywhere you want to brighten or cover imperfections, like under your eyes or on a breakout.

products.title: Brows and Lashes
products.body_html: Define your eyes with our staples for brows and lashes. Our Tinted Brow Gel gives the easiest fluffy brow in just a few swipes. It lifts without a heavy, crunchy finish, and has enough pigment to make your brows look fuller. And our Lifting and Defining Mascara glides on easily with a brush that was designed to coat every lash for that soft, fluttery look without clumping.

products.title: Color and Sculpt
products.body_html: Bring color, dimension and glow to your skin with our essential trio. Warm up your face with Bronzer Stick for a natural, sun-kissed look. Add a pop of color to your cheeks with Blush Stick. Finish with Illuminating Stick on the high points of your face, adding a soft glow to the skin.
products.product_type: The Highlight, Bronze & Blush Stick Trio

products.title: Full Face
products.body_html: Create the easiest makeup look with these everyday staples. Perfect your skin with our Serum Concealer, formulated with brightening ingredients. Layer on Blush Stick, a buildable formula that can go on sheer or be built up for a bolder pop of color. Our Lifting and Defining Mascara gives lashes a fluttery look in just a few swipes. Finish with Lip Blush, a balmy, tinted formula that adds a hint of natural-looking color to lips.

products.title: Face, Lips, Cheeks
products.body_html: The everyday routine that makes doing your makeup beyond simple. Perfect your skin with our Skin Tint, a nourishing serum with buildable coverage that protects with mineral SPF 40. Our multi-use, buildable cream Blush Stick melts into cheeks (lips and eyes too if you're feeling monochromatic) for a wash of color. Apply both using our Multi-Tasking Brush, made to do it all. Finish your look with our Tinted Lip Serum, which gives just the right amount of soft, glossy shine and a pop of color while it hydrates.

products.title: PM Routine
products.body_html: Smooth your skin from head to toe with this trio of face, lip and body scrubs. The Exfoliating Body Scrub is a full-body physical and chemical exfoliator that features AHAs (lactic and glycolic acids) and finely-ground pumice to help get rid of bumps, dry patches, and uneven skin tone. Our Exfoliating Lip Scrub is made with a mix of chemical and physical exfoliants to gently remove flakes while nourishing and hydrating the lips. And our Microcrystal Exfoliator is a gentle face scrub that refines pores and gently buffs away dead skin for brighter skin, smoother texture, and more even tone.

products.title: Face and Eyes
products.body_html: Perfect your skin, define your lashes, and take it all off at the end of the day. Our multi-tasking Skin Tint is a nourishing serum with light, buildable coverage that instantly corrects uneven skin tone and protects with mineral SPF 40. Our Lifting and Defining Mascara lengthens and adds definition with a lightweight formula that glides on easily without clumping. And our oil-based Cleansing Balm removes the day's makeup and impurities without stripping or drying skin.

Vegan | Cruelty-Free

Whether you’re looking for an (adorable) way to pull your locks back pre-skincare, want to up your hair game with zero effort, or are just in need of another way to rep your love of Versed, this terrycloth headband deserves a spot in your shopping cart. products.title: Glide-And-Go
products.body_html: Our skincare spatula offers a mess-free and hygienic way to apply your skincare products. Made with a 100% silicone head, it spreads masks, serums, and moisturizers evenly without absorbing product. The soft, flexible design is gentle on all skin types, while the easy-to-clean applicator prevents bacteria buildup. Durable and reusable, this tool ensures a more efficient and sanitary skincare routine.

products.title: Mood Lighting
products.body_html: These liquid illuminating glow drops feel like a serum and act like the perfect, dewy highlighter. Superfine, light-reflecting pigments add a natural glow and even out the appearance of uneven tone, while helping to boost hydration.

products.title: Terry Headband
products.body_html: The Versed Headband became synonymous with the get-unready-with-me. In 2019, we launched The Versed Headband and it became synonymous with your night time skincare routines – we’ve brought it back, elevated so you can also wear it during the day.

products.title: Face Diffuser
products.body_html: A multi-tasking brush designed to blend in complexion products for the most skin-like finish. The oval shape was designed for the contours of your face for more precise application. The ultra-soft vegan bristles blend without ever feeling rough.

products.title: Smooth Skin
products.body_html: This primer is the answer to a smoother application and longer-lasting makeup. Non-comedogenic and dermatologist-tested, our formula adds a subtle radiance that blurs fine lines and pores. It feels like nothing on skin, making it easy to layer products on top without making your skin feel heavy.

products.title: Cloud Polish
products.body_html: The secret for smooth lips, this scrub is made with a mix of chemical and physical exfoliants to gently slough away dead skin and remove flakes while nourishing and hydrating the lips' delicate skin.

products.title: Cloud Wrap
products.body_html: This leave-on lip mask helps replenish and hydrate dry lips. Smooth and never sticky, this overnight mask doubles as a wearable, all-day balm to soften flaky, rough skin.

products.title: Cashmere Color
products.body_html: The easiest way to play up your natural lip color, this balm gives a touch of color and a smoothing soft-matte finish. It feels like a balm, hydrates like skincare, and gives your lips that perfect, lived-in look.

products.title: Soft Gloss
products.body_html: A serum for your lips. This sheer lip tint gives just the right amount of soft, glossy shine and a pop of color. With moisturizing ingredients, it feels like skincare for your lips, keeping them hydrated and comfortable all day long.

products.title: Easy Brow
products.body_html: The perfect fluffy brow. An easy-to-use, volume-boosting formula, this tinted brow gel effortlessly lifts without a heavy, crunchy finish. Plus, biotin helps maintain and boost the thickness and strength of your brows.

products.title: Sheer Stay
products.body_html: With the performance of a powder and the flexibility of a cream, this liquid eyeshadow adds a touch of sheen to lids. Its soft shimmer formula can be worn on its own for a wash of color, or layered for a bit of depth and dimension.

products.title: Day Lash
products.body_html: This mascara lifts, lengthens, and defines without the clumps. The lightweight and water-resistant formula glides on easily with a brush that was designed to coat every lash for that soft, fluttery look. Easy, natural, and just the right amount of oomph.

products.title: Warm Dimension
products.body_html: This creamy bronzer formula adds natural warmth and glow without looking patchy or dry. Made to blend right in, you can layer to build up the intensity wherever you want.

products.title: High Points
products.body_html: This highlighter is made with nourishing ingredients and super-fine pearl for a natural, dewy glow. Meant to instantly make your skin more luminous, this feels like nothing and layers well over other products. It's that lit-from-within glow that's never shimmery or sparkly.

products.title: Shade Swipe
products.body_html: This multi-use, buildable cream blush melts into cheeks (lips too if you're feeling monochromatic). The formula is flexible, lightweight, and easy to layer, so you can go for a soft wash of color or build it up for a more pigmented look.

products.title: Skin Solution
products.body_html: This weightless concealer feels like a hydrating serum and delivers medium coverage that goes on creamy and blends right in. Infused with ingredients that care for the delicate skin around your eyes, it won’t settle into fine lines or wrinkles. Instead, it gently blurs for a smooth, skin-like finish. Plus, the formula self-sets, so don't have to worry about creasing.

products.title: Skin Solution
products.body_html:
The hero in your routine, this skin-perfecting tint is a nourishing serum with buildable coverage that corrects uneven skin tone and protects with mineral SPF 40. With a skin-like finish, this feels lightweight and gives a lit-from-within, hydrating glow that stays put all day. Made with ingredients that feel like skincare and will care for your skin, you can wear all day without worrying about clogging your pores or irritating your skin.

Tip: A little goes a long way. Start with a pea-sized amount and build in light layers to your desired coverage. This keeps the finish looking natural, not heavy.

products.title: Daily Routine
products.body_html: These daily essentials boost skin's glow, without irritation. Our oil-based Cleansing Balm removes makeup and impurities without stripping or drying skin. Brightening Serum brightens skin and evens out tone, and is made with vitamin C that's gentle enough for even sensitive skin. The Brightening Eye Gel cools on contact to ease puffiness while targeting dark circles and delivering an instantly refreshed look to the eye area. Finish with our Moisture Cream, designed to hydrate your skin without feeling heavy or greasy.

products.title: Instant Gratification
products.body_html:
The results you’ve been waiting for—without the wait. Our  dermaplaner delivers noticeably brighter, smoother skin in just one use. But this is no disposable, flimsy shaver. Its slip-free grip and stainless steel, single-edge blade provide the closest, safest exfoliation you can get outside an office—no batteries required. It removes dead skin cells and facial hair (which, no, won’t grow back thicker) seamlessly and painlessly. The reusable metal handle is meant to take up permanent space on your vanity while each blade lasts for at least 3-4 uses. After a few minutes with the tool, you’ll see more even-toned skin and feel a softer complexion. Plus, every other product in your regimen will work more effectively as clearing the top layers of skin allows products to penetrate deeper. And just wait until you see how your makeup applies after dermaplaning… Flawless.

Each tool comes with 2 blades, a 2-6 month supply depending on how often you dermaplane.

Blade refill 3-pack sold separately.

products.title: PM Routine
products.body_html: This smoothing body duo visibly transforms rough, dull, uneven skin. Our creamy exfoliating scrub has AHAs (lactic and glycolic acids) that work hand-in-hand with microfine pumice to banish bumps, target hyperpigmentation, and polish away dry patches, leaving skin soft and radiant. It's paired with our best-selling retinol-infused body lotion, which helps target body breakouts, chicken skin, strawberry legs, and more for smooth-as-glass skin all over.

products.title: Doctor's Visit
products.body_html: This mask doubles as an at-home facial for brighter, smoother skin. AHAs, BHAs, and enzymes improve uneven tone and texture  for visible results in just two minutes.

products.title: Buff It Out
products.body_html: This all-over body scrub helps get rid of dull, rough, and bumpy skin. Glycolic and lactic acids are paired with pomegranate enzymes and pumice for a chemical and physical exfoliation that gently and effectively smooths the entire body.

products.title: Press Restart
products.body_html:
Retinol doesn’t just have great benefits for your face. This body lotion helps 
firm skin, smooth texture, and brighten dullness — all while delivering nourishing hydration everywhere.

products.title: Press Restart
products.body_html: Gentle enough for sensitive skin and first-time retinol users, this serum delivers the tone and texture-reforming benefits of retinol without the "uglies": redness, dryness, or peeling.

products.title: Weekend Glow
products.body_html: Replace your entire PM routine with this one glow-boosting mask. Gentle enough for sensitive skin or back-to-back use, this formula delivers visible results while you sleep. We paired AHAs and vitamin A to exfoliate, brighten, and hydrate skin, while soothing ingredients prevent redness and irritation.

products.title: Water Rush
products.body_html: Instantly refresh tired, puffy eyes with this lightweight, hyaluronic acid-packed gel. It feels like water on the skin, but delivers the lasting moisture of a cream.

products.title: Skin Soothe
products.body_html:
This hydrating, milky toner soothes skin, restores balance, and adds a light layer of moisture that preps skin for the serums and moisturizers that follow.

Formerly Baby Cheeks

products.title: Water Rush
products.body_html: An instant dose of moisture that sinks into dehydrated skin. Pro vitamin B5 calms skin and helps lock in moisture, while five molecular weights of hyaluronic acid deliver hydration. These forms of HA prevent water loss while helping moisture sink into the skin.

products.title: Good Defense
products.body_html: Our SPF 50 hydrates just as well as it protects. This gel-cream sunscreen has a dewy, glowy finish that perks up skin and keeps skin moisturized.

products.title: Skin Soak
products.body_html: This ultra-hydrating formula uses hyaluronic acid to add and help retain moisture. Made with soothing ingredients, this moisturizer helps keep skin calm, locks in your serums, and never feels heavy under SPF or makeup.

products.title: Dew Point
products.body_html: A lightweight moisturizing gel-cream that absorbs into skin instantly. This moisturizer never feels greasy, and won't clog pores.

products.title: Day Maker
products.body_html: This gentle exfoliating cleanser refines the appearance of pores while brightening, smoothing, and clarifying skin. Its creamy, nourishing formula replenishes moisture while it exfoliates so it won't strip your skin.

products.title: The Purist
products.body_html: This gentle, antioxidant-rich cleanser lathers up to remove dirt, oil, and makeup without drying out your skin. You’re left feeling soft and hydrated—never stripped.

products.title: Day Dissolve
products.body_html: The first step in your cleansing routine, this cleansing balm melts away makeup (yes, even waterproof formulas) and washes away impurities without stripping skin. It preps skin for your second cleanse without leaving your skin feeling tight and dry.

This daily antioxidant serum is formulated with a gentle, effective form of vitamin C that’s perfect for even sensitive skin. It visibly brightens dull skin, helping to improve the look of uneven tone and signs of aging over time. 
This non-sticky formula leaves a glowy finish, without redness.

products.title: Weekend Glow
products.body_html: A shot of espresso for your eyes, this weightless, caffeine-infused gel cools on contact to ease puffiness while targeting dark circles and delivering an instantly refreshed look to the eye area.
